conflict_claim: Uploaded Sprint 19 ZIP shows evidence HEAD as bd71e09; final Sprint 19 response claims main @ b9d3662

resolution.explanation: The Sprint 19 ZIP was created DURING Sprint 19 execution — specifically after evidence files were written but BEFORE the Sprint 19 git commit b9d3662 was made. The git-status-initial.txt and git-log-proof.txt in the ZIP correctly capture the state at the START of Sprint 19 (HEAD=bd71e09, the Sprint 18 commit). After the evidence files were written and the ZIP was created, the Sprint 19 commit b9d3662 was made, which included those exact evidence files. The ZIP is missing git-status-final.txt and git-diff-final.patch — those would have shown HEAD=b9d3662. That is the actual gap: the bundle contract did not enforce capture of post-commit final state.
resolution.root_cause: Sprint 19 bundle contract did not require git-status-final.txt. The ZIP was created before git commit, so HEAD in ZIP = bd71e09 (correct at that moment). Final response stated HEAD = b9d3662 (correct after commit).
